description: Fires when the left edge column (column 0) holds exactly four stones and the top one (row 4 from the bottom) is the opponent's, mostly when the opponent has just played it there, or when my stones sit directly beneath it. Strongest on sparse early boards. It weakens as the board fills up and with each move since that stone was played. It is off when that stone is mine, and it does not fire for other columns.
effect: Weak: forcing it high or off moves the policy by at most about 5-7 points (e.g. +7 on column 3 and -5 on column 5 in one position); in most positions there is no measurable change.
notes: Base pattern from examples: col0 height 4 with their stone on top. p1 (plus my stone at row 3) F1 .704 sim .70; p2/p5 (base and either last move in col0 or my stones at rows 2-3) F1 .736, P .63, R .88, AUROC .93, sim share .71. Minimal pairs: one extra move (making the top stone mine) kills it; the same pattern in cols 1, 2 or 6 gives about 0; filling the board drops it from 5.6 to 2.1. Exceptions: some height-5 columns with their stone at row 3 or 4 fire on sparse boards, but adding that case collapsed precision (F1 .38). Synthesis max 9.04, below the dev max of 9.83.
